agent_notes: Only census-mirror sites (census2011.co.in, onefivenine.com, villageinfo.in) confirm a real village 'Birmana'/'Beermana' (code 069240) in Lunkaransar tehsil, Bikaner, panchayat Khokhrana, population 429 (2011). No social media, video, image, temple/gotra, book, or legal-database hit was found for this village under any spelling. GeoNames has NO entry for a Birmana in Bikaner district at all — its only 'Birmana' hit is a different, unrelated populated place in Suratgarh tehsil, Ganganagar district (~29.17N 73.73E), which must not be conflated with this unit. Crucially, no source found (including the Patrika displacement feature on Mahajan Field Firing Range, which names Bhojrasar, Kumbhana, Motlai, Khanisar, Thoiya, Maneran, Duder instead) independently confirms Birmana was among the 34 villages acquired for the firing range — this unit's inclusion still rests solely on the original Facebook comment list per its notes field. Census mirrors also disagree with each other on pincode, distance-to-Lunkaransar, distance-to-Bikaner and literacy rate for the same village code, so these are recorded as conflicting claims for the pipeline to reconcile.
